item.title: Scuffles and fires break out as protesters rally across France, joining students
item.description: Demonstrators across France converged with students Saturday to protest rising living costs, as the country's fiscal crisis deepens.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV leaves hospital days after lung cancer surgery
item.description: The Pope left Rome's Gemelli Hospital Saturday, days after surgery for lung cancer removed the lower lobe of his right lung. He is currently scheduled to travel to Latin America in November.

item.title: Fraud, affordability and Trump policies drive friction in Minnesota Senate debate

item.title: Dozens of critically endangered orangutans rescued from Indonesian wildfires
item.description: Rescuers in Indonesia have saved dozens of orangutans from wildfires. The critically endangered species is fighting for their lives and habitats during this deadly wildfire season.

item.title: Decades after apartheid, South Africans seek justice for crimes of the past
item.description:
More than three decades after the end of apartheid, families of victims of some of the worst crimes of South Africa's past
are still fighting for justice. As survivors and perpetrators grow older, a new wave of legal efforts is seeking truth, accountability and reparations before it's too late.

item.title: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
item.description: Patients travel miles to be treated at public hospitals in Delhi. Those in need get financial aid for their care. But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street.
